subject.title: Improve China Kimi/GLM routes: Coding Plan 5h, Kimi Monthly, clearer labels

question: Should Kimi Monthly enrichment be permitted to read a Kimi Desktop or browser session during API/CLI usage refreshes, and if so, what explicit setting should authorize it?
rationale: The patch introduces automatic access to a separate authenticated web session while preserving a setting that appears to control cookie sourcing; choosing the intended consent model is product and privacy policy, not a mechanical review choice.

options.title: Honor the existing cookie-source control
options.body: Only perform Desktop/browser session enrichment when the configured cookie source permits it, preserving API/CLI-only refreshes as session-cookie-free by default.

options.title: Add a dedicated Monthly enrichment setting
options.body: Expose a separate opt-in for Kimi Monthly enrichment and document that it may access an available Kimi web session.

options.title: Accept automatic enrichment
options.body: Retain unconditional discovery and document that Kimi API/CLI refreshes may use an available Desktop or browser session.

recommendation.title: Honor the existing cookie-source control
recommendation.body: Only perform Desktop/browser session enrichment when the configured cookie source permits it, preserving API/CLI-only refreshes as session-cookie-free by default.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the best available decision route for an automatic credential-discovery and consent-policy change.
